question: Does a same-timeframe BigBeluga Volumatic VIDYA trend-direction entry gate improve frozen SPIKE V12.9 ordinary entries on OKX ETHUSDT.P 5m/15m and a pre-ranked 20-alt Binance USD-M sample after 0.2% round-trip cost, and does the admitted signal beat a trend-matched random entry?
single_variable: Entry admission only: keep a V12.9 ordinary signal iff the confirmed signal-bar close has the same Volumatic VIDYA trend direction as the signal. Re-run the non-overlapping serial ledger so rejected entries do not occupy positions. All exits, stops, fills, prior BB/overheat/HTF gates, costs and raw signal rules are frozen.

vidya.trend_rule: Up state turns on when confirmed close crosses above the upper band; down state turns on when confirmed close crosses below the lower band; otherwise retain the prior state.
vidya.used_for_admission: Current chart-timeframe trend state only. The Volumatic volume-delta readout and pivot annotations do not add entry conditions.

altcoins_binance.universe_rule: Reuse the 20 Binance USD-M alts selected by median daily quote volume before the study window in exp-spike-v129-alts-confirm-20261011-v1; BTC, ETH and stablecoins remain excluded.

execution.exit_engine: V12.9 ordinary serial ledger: 5-bar extreme plus 0.2 ATR stop, minimum 2 ATR initial risk, close-2R-armed 4 ATR trail, raw opposite exit
execution.position_policy: one position at a time per symbol and timeframe; all archive events warm occupancy before the result window
execution.matched_control: One deterministic random entry per admitted trade, matched on same symbol, signal side, UTC week, study fold, causal ATR/close bin, and the same VIDYA trend state; same entry/exit engine and 0.2% cost.

primary: For each timeframe in the pooled 20-alt set, the admitted trades must have positive mean net R in both periods and positive excess over the trend-state-matched random control with a calendar-month block sign-flip p < 0.01 in both periods. ETH is a separately reported reference. Every result remains research-only.
notes: This is a single admission-gate study. It does not tune VIDYA parameters and does not claim TradingView-native backtest parity.
Baseline ledgers must reproduce the saved V12.9 ordinary trades before the gated run is accepted.
No monitor, forward producer, active bundle, threshold preset, account, or live execution behavior is changed.
